newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Telecinco gets 20 bln pta syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Spain Telecinco gets 20 bln pta syndicated loan.

text.p: Spanish Television broadcaster Telecinco said on Thursday it had received a syndicated loan for 20 billion pesetas.
The facility will be available for 2-1/2 years, with a final maturity of five years. After the first 3.5 years, repayments must be made every six months.
Chase Manhattan bank was the lead manager.
Interest payments will be 0.5 percent over Mibor, with initial fees of 0.25 percent.

Telecinco announced at the end of January its intention to be publicly listed. It is now owned 25 percent by the Kirch group, 25 percent by Mediaset, 25 percent by Sotelcin, 10 percent by Prensa Espanola, 13 percent by the International Bank of Luxembourg and the remaining two percent lies in the hands of minority shareholders.
